instruction.task: Replace your current script with a robust long-running fallback earner that never exits just because rooted targets are absent. Behavior: maintain a hardcoded candidate list of very early servers such as n00dles, foodnstuff, sigma-cosmetics, joesguns, nectar-net, hong-fang-tea, harakiri-sushi. Repeatedly choose the rooted candidate with the highest maxMoney; if none are rooted yet, choose n00dles anyway. Then loop forever on that target: if security > minSecurityLevel + 5, weaken; else if money < 0.9 * maxMoney, grow; else hack. Refresh min/max/security/money each cycle. Print target selection occasionally. Do not use ns.getServer or expensive analysis APIs. Do not return early if root is missing; instead sleep a bit and retry selection, but if n00dles is hackable/rooted use it immediately. Keep code compact and RAM-cheap.

instruction.task: Replace your current script with a minimal long-running self-starting earner that should work even with very limited access. Use a hardcoded candidate list of early servers: n00dles, foodnstuff, sigma-cosmetics, nectar-net, joesguns, hong-fang-tea, harakiri-sushi. In an infinite loop, pick the rooted candidate with the largest maxMoney among those whose required hacking level is <= current hacking level. If none qualify, fall back to n00dles if its required level is met, otherwise sleep and retry. Once a target is chosen, repeatedly refresh its current money, max money, current security, and min security, then: weaken if security > min+5; else grow if money < 0.9*max; else hack. If hack/grow/weaken throws due to missing root or invalid target, catch the error, sleep briefly, and go back to selection instead of exiting. Print target changes occasionally. Avoid ns.getServer and all expensive analysis APIs. Keep RAM very low and make sure the script never returns unless killed.
